summary: The account04/B03 unweighted two-square L2 compiler drops a required |t|^(1/2) factor in its displayed Cauchy-Schwarz rewrite and has impossible coefficient/density-cap homogeneity. For Z,W iid Uniform[0,1] and a=b=1e-4, support length gives ||p||_2^2>=5000 while the claimed bound is about 570.289. A correct replacement is ||p_(aZ^2+bW^2)||_2^2 <= 3sqrt(3) M_Z M_W |ab|^(-1/2) by square-density L^(4/3) control and sharp Young, hence P(|Y-Y'|<=eps)<=6sqrt(3) M_Z M_W |ab|^(-1/2) eps. The full QFORM conjecture is not refuted and remains open.
